peers.name: KEYCORP /NEW/
peers.rationale: Large regional bank with similar commercial and consumer banking mix, comparable asset size, overlapping Northeast/Midwest footprint; useful for regional bank multiples.

peers.name: CITIZENS FINANCIAL GROUP INC/RI
peers.rationale: Northeast-focused super-regional bank of similar scale to MTB, comparable commercial lending and retail deposit franchise.

peers.name: REGIONS FINANCIAL CORP
peers.rationale: Regional bank holding company with similar balance sheet size and diversified commercial/consumer banking, though more Southeast-weighted footprint than MTB.

peers.name: FIFTH THIRD BANCORP
peers.rationale: Comparable-size regional bank with similar business mix of commercial banking, consumer lending and wealth management.

peers.name: HUNTINGTON BANCSHARES INC /MD/
peers.rationale: Midwest regional bank of similar scale to MTB with overlapping geographic markets and comparable commercial/consumer banking model.

peers.name: TRUIST FINANCIAL CORP
peers.rationale: Large super-regional bank; broader national footprint and larger scale than MTB, but similar diversified banking model provides a useful, if imperfect, comparison.

peers.name: ZIONS BANCORPORATION, NATIONAL ASSOCIATION /UT/
peers.rationale: Regional bank with community banking focus comparable to MTB's model, though smaller scale and different Western geographic footprint.
